eps.t: A Single Man and a Little Girl Meet
eps.ov: After a poor childhood, Hajime grew up and made a living as an adventurer. But then he meets another orphan...
An acquaintance of Hajime's comes to verify Rirui's identity, but may have even more in mind.
Rirui makes friends with an aspiring young dwarf craftswoman, Anyango.
Hajime and Rirui explore a dungeon that's due for demolition before meeting a new acquaintance.
Will Rirui's egg hatch before Hajime turns it into breakfast?

eps.t: Decisive Battle in the Dungeon Attack!
eps.ov: Veronica invites Hajime and Rirui to the city of Yanago to help her with some business trouble.
A beaster scholar and his daughter enlist Hajime and Rirui's help, but sparks fly between the two kids.
Hajime butts heads with a member of the village watch, as a magic beast from distant lands becomes a threat.
Hajime lost an arm protecting Rirui, and finds himself having to adjust to the changes in his life.
After helping Hajime with his increasingly unruly hair, Veronica gets dragged away by a giant spider!
Rirui awakens to a new succubus power, but it has unexpected and troublesome side effects...
Rirui's Charm power is activating while she sleeps, attracting monsters and leaving Hajime at a loss.
